planningItems.title: Initialize a git repository for ITPMS
planningItems.description: No version control exists on this project yet. Two (now three, observed live during this session) silent db_store.json data reverts have happened — this is the single highest-value safety net still missing.

planningItems.title: i18n: OfficialITParkDashboard.tsx + ExecutiveIdeasHub.tsx
planningItems.description: Completed — both views now use the shared t() translation system for their English UI chrome (the Uzbek government-report facsimile content in OfficialITParkDashboard was left as authentic Uzbek by design).

planningItems.title: Configure a real Google Maps API key
planningItems.description: The Infrastructure / Property Marketplace map views are still running on the placeholder key from setup.

planningItems.title: Strategic Planning & Roadmap module + sidebar entry
planningItems.description: This module: a project-wide board of next steps (this very item), replacing the static roadmap document with something the team can edit directly.

planningItems.title: Persist properties + build Edit/Verify Profile for Infrastructure
planningItems.description: Properties existed only as frontend seed data with zero backend persistence. Added a properties collection to db_store.json (seeded via seed_properties.mts), wired onAddProperty/onUpdateProperty through the generic entity API, and built an Edit / Verify Property form (room count, parking, available-from date, marketplace status, AC/meeting rooms, verified-on-site checkbox). i18n for this module and its new fields is still outstanding.

planningItems.title: Security hardening pass
planningItems.description: Open /api/auth/register endpoint, placeholder JWT secrets, and a wildcard CORS_ORIGIN all need a decision on the right production posture before go-live.

planningItems.title: i18n: AnalyticsModule.tsx
planningItems.description: Completed — cross-module charts, KPIs, the Custom Report Studio, and the AI forecast card's surrounding text are now translated (the 'Gemini' brand name itself was left as-is).

planningItems.title: Per-KPI target edit on Executive Dashboard
planningItems.description: Admins can now adjust a KPI's annual and quarterly targets inline from the Strategic Scorecard instead of the values being hardcoded in kpiData.ts.

planningItems.title: Rename AI Copilot branding to Google Studio
planningItems.description: All user-facing 'AI Copilot' labels, chat greetings, and dashboard copy switched to 'Google Studio' wording after the provider switch back to Gemini.

planningItems.title: Residents module i18n (Uzbek / Russian)
planningItems.description: 33 files across dashboard, audit, and pipeline sub-views. Work was split into 4 batches and paused mid-way; a few stray scratch files in _i18n_scratch/ need review before the merge into LanguageContext.tsx.

planningItems.title: Build Edit Profile for the Residents module
planningItems.description: ResidentProfileDetail.tsx had no edit state, save handler, or Edit button at all — the largest module in the app (11 sub-views) had zero ability to correct a resident's data after creation. Added an Edit Profile modal covering company registry data, contact info, status, financials, and tax benefits, wired through the existing onUpdate CRUD path.

planningItems.title: Build Edit Profile for the Talent module + i18n
planningItems.description: Talent had zero edit-related code -- candidate records (test scores, contact info, status) could only ever be added, never corrected. Added onUpdate wiring end to end (TalentModuleProps -> App.tsx -> EntityService), an 'Edit Profile' button in the candidate detail drawer that reopens the existing registration form pre-filled, and a dynamic modal title/submit label for add vs. edit. Confirmed Talent's RBAC entity-permission mapping correctly falls through to the existing infrastructure.read/infrastructure.manage default -- no RBAC change needed. Full en/uz/ru translation pass also completed for the entire module (58 t() call sites, 53 new dictionary keys) since the module had never been translated at all.

planningItems.title: Edit Profile pattern for CRM (companies/contacts) + fix dormant comment-edit
planningItems.description: Companies and contacts in the CRM module had no edit or delete path at all -- built full Edit Profile support for both (status field added to companies, phone/notes added to contacts, delete-with-confirmation for both), matching the Events module's pattern. Separately, CommentCard.tsx already had a fully-coded 'Edit Post' menu item and isAuthor check that was never wired up (onEditComment was never passed from CommentsModule.tsx) -- wired it to a small edit modal so authors can now edit their own posted comments; delete-own-comment was already working. This closes out the last item of the module-by-module Edit Profile audit -- Startups, Residents, Infrastructure, Talent, and now CRM/Comments are all done.
